col_4: Each GPIO port C pin (GPIO64-GPIO87) corresponds to one bit in this register as shown in Figure 1-70. Writes of 0 are ignored. This register always reads back a 0. Writing a 1 forces the respective output data latch to low. If the pin is configured as a GPIO output then it will be driven low. If the pin is not configured as a GPIO output then the latch is cleared but the pin is not driven.
